CHANGE ONLY the two hand fragments: the upper-left pressing finger and the middle-right pinching thumb/index. They currently look like photographed human skin and nails. Re-render these same poses/contact points as solid IVORY MODELING CLAY sculptural hand fragments, in the same clay3D medium as the purple material. Keep smooth matte-to-satin clay surfaces with a few restrained kneaded marks; REMOVE photorealistic skin pores, fine epidermal wrinkles, realistic nail plates/nail beds/cuticles. Simplify the digits into clear rounded sculpted forms while preserving recognizable correct hand contact and anatomy. The pressing finger must still visibly indent the top purple pad; the pinch must still visibly stretch the middle purple neck. Ivory is their color, not skin. Match the existing upper-left key light and lower-right cast shadows. Do not turn them into glossy plastic or foam. Do not cover any text.

PRESERVE the native parent's entire poster composition, exact readable raised Korean title, all six strings, yellow/violet complementary strength, continuous single purple press–stretch–rest flow, directional pulled-clay folds, plump resting end, margins and strong shadows. Keep the bottom venue fully legible; no changes to copy, title strokes, event date or wording. No new decoration or effects.

The following is the full original request and complete constraints/specification. The original five-poster count is centrally managed; this edit remains only the assigned ONE portrait poster.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one complete exhibition poster, edge-to-edge single flat poster image with opaque background, portrait 2:3.
You are making only the assigned R6-C4-M4 portrait poster. The original request describes a five-poster set managed centrally; this call must create exactly ONE independent poster, never a grid, contact sheet, scene of framed posters, or multiple versions.

Full original user request (verbatim; instruction context, not extra printed copy):
가상 점토 조각전 '말랑한 중력'의 덕테이프 포스터 5장을 만들어줘. 모두 클레이 3D, 두툼하게 솟은 입체 한글, 강한 보색을 써서 과감하고 장난스럽게 표현해줘. 누르거나 늘어지거나 다시 제자리로 돌아오는 말랑한 조각의 행동이 보여야 해. 효과를 줄여서 얌전한 평면 포스터로 바꾸지 말고, 입체 글자의 한글은 또렷이 읽히게 해줘. 세로 2:3 두 장, 정사각형 두 장, 가로 3:2 한 장으로 총 5장. 문구는 아래 그대로, 추가 문구나 로고 없이 부탁해.

SOFT GRAVITY
움직이는 점토 조각전
누르고, 늘리고, 다시 놓기
2026.12.05–12.13

Assigned content-to-form relation: pressing, stretching, and returning to rest form THREE distinguishable consecutive zones of ONE physically continuous clay flow. The action sentence organizes those zones in semantic order rather than sitting in a generic caption band. This is one sculptural relation within one composition, no separate panels, arrows, numerical labels, or multiple disconnected objects.

Composition and action:
Use a vivid lemon-yellow opaque studio field and intensely saturated violet clay: a strong complementary purple/yellow relationship. The primary Korean title is thick, raised, unmistakably clay 3D, with broad intact normal Hangul strokes and generous open counters. Render 말랑한 as one large upper line and 중력 as the next large line, with expressive staggered optical alignment; still read the complete title instantly. Bold volume and contact shadows are essential, not flat letter silhouettes.
A single generous violet clay flow occupies and activates the middle and lower-middle of the portrait. Its top zone is a broad soft pad visibly compressed by the contact of one simple ivory clay finger, showing a clear deep press depression and outward squash. From that exact same pad the material continues into a long hanging neck through the middle, visibly thinning and lengthening under the gentle pinch/pull of a second simple ivory clay thumb-and-index fragment. The uninterrupted neck then releases into a plump rounded resting end lower down, visibly regaining mass and roundness against the same yellow ground. Make the continuous material connection obvious, not three independent blobs. Keep the simple sculptural hand fragments anatomically readable and confined to their functional contact points; no people or unrelated props.
Arrange the three existing phrase fragments 누르고, / 늘리고, / 다시 놓기 in order adjacent to the corresponding three zones, each readable, with consistent strong dark-violet type on clean yellow space. Together they must reproduce the exact supplied sentence once. Build the scene around their actual width and adjacency, leaving explicit separation from the clay contours. No invented labels, symbols or additional text. The clay flow must not cover, fuse with, or deform any mandatory letter.
The raised title, compressed pad, elongated neck and round resting end share one matte-to-satin hand-shaped clay material and one upper-left lighting rule, with rich lower-right cast shadows that explain depth. Use restrained tiny modeling irregularities selectively; no universal grain overlay, plastic chrome shine, neon glow, floating confetti, decorative spheres or unrelated effect kit. Preserve the requested bold playful energy and substantial 3D effects.
SOFT GRAVITY is a clear smaller companion to the title. 움직이는 점토 조각전 is a readable secondary descriptor connecting the title to the action. Date and venue get a generous stable reading surface in the lower part with strong contrast, clear word spaces, open letter shapes, and comfortable margins. Their width must be planned before the sculpture; never horizontally crush the long bilingual venue line. A natural line break at / is allowed if needed, with the full exact line preserved semantically. Use legible dark violet lettering, without copying the big title's depth onto every small text line.

All mandatory conditions:

- Full clay 3D, thick raised readable Korean title, strong complementary colors, bold playful expression. Do not reduce effects into a quiet flat minimalist design.
- At least one pressing/stretching/returning action clearly identifiable in this image; assigned direction organizes all three in one continuous flow.
- Intact normal Hangul; never close internal counters or melt neighboring characters together.
- One coherent clay form/surface/light system; sufficient readable surfaces for information.
